subject: Conflict between Foundation Plan S-101 and Sheet S-301 over the cast-in anchor bolt group

messages.text: The cast-in anchor bolt group location shown in Foundation Plan S-101 at Gridline E/9 conflicts with the mechanical ductwork and architectural ceiling framing routing shown in Sheet S-301. This needs immediate attention -- please prioritize a response. No cost impact is anticipated either way. This is holding up steel fabrication release. We need this resolved before the next steel erection mobilization.

Revise the cast-in anchor bolt group per Sheet S-301; coordinate final dimensions with the affected trades before fabrication. No cost impact is anticipated either way. This is holding up steel fabrication release.

To confirm, should the cast-in anchor bolt group at Gridline E/9 remain per Foundation Plan S-101, or do we wait for a revised Sheet S-301? We need this resolved before the next steel erection mobilization.
